protocol.purpose: Bounded-budget, full-dataset paired comparisons; not a large-model or universal non-regression certification
protocol.selection_metric: final validation loss only; test data never opened during tuning

vision.training_data: All training examples after fixed 10% validation split; no dataset subsampling

pinn.test_grid: Midpoints of 1024 equal cells; validation grid includes endpoints

acceptance.numeric: No failed confirmation trial or nonfinite loss/gradient/rate/model output
acceptance.vision: Paired exact-bootstrap 95% lower bound for DLRS minus each tuned baseline test accuracy must be >= -1.0 percentage point
acceptance.pinn: Paired exact-bootstrap 95% upper bound for geometric mean DLRS/baseline relative-RMSE ratio must be <= 1.10 against each tuned baseline
acceptance.timing: Record paired median wall-time ratios; exploratory on a shared thermally constrained laptop, not a deployment SLO
acceptance.scope: A pass applies only to these fixed horizons/models/data/hyperparameter search budgets; it does not close CUDA, multi-node, or large-model gaps
